core.headline: Three-bedroom freehold terrace, Lordswood, no onward chain
core.summary: Guide Price £285,000. Freehold ex-local-authority mid-terrace house in Fernhill Close, Lordswood. Three bedrooms, lounge, kitchen/diner, lean-to utility. Gas central heating, Worcester boiler 2019. Rear garden with gate to shared path. No chain.
core.listing:
Guide Price £285,000. Freehold ex-local-authority mid-terrace house in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham. No onward chain.

The accommodation comprises a lounge measuring 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"), a kitchen/diner measuring 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"), and a lean-to utility. Upstairs are three bedrooms: bedroom one 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"), bedroom two 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8"), and bedroom three 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). One bathroom.

Gas central heating with a Worcester boiler installed in 2019. Rear garden measuring approx. 9m (30ft) with gate to shared rear path. On-street parking, no permit required.

Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Construction: brick under a concrete tiled roof. Electricity, water (metered) and sewerage are mains. Broadband: FTTC. Pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. Building safety, restrictions, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.

Damp mark on bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. Seller unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
